title: Technology Partners
snippet:
---
### What you’ll need
Do you have a tool that integrates with GitHub? In addition to making your integration publicly available, there are a few boxes you’ll need to check before you’re eligible to be a Technology Partner.
#### Users
You’ll need at least 5,000 integration users and at least 10 current GitHub Enterprise customers.
#### Compatibility
Your integration will need to support both GitHub Enterprise and GitHub.com.
#### Testimonial
You’ll need at least one integration testimonial from a GitHub Enterprise customer.
## Technical Requirements
---
#### Use TLS
Anytime you display GitHub data in your integration, use TLS. Use SSL/TLS if you use any webhooks to receive updated data from GitHub.
#### Delete old user data
Delete GitHub user data within 60 days upon request.
#### Use GitHub API best practices
- Use webhooks, not GitHub API polls, whenever possible.
- Don’t ask for more GitHub access than needed.
- Allow users to delete their accounts through your service.

title: About GitHub Partner Support - GitHub Enterprise Cloud Docs
snippet:
Get help resolving issues for your customers with GitHub Partner Support. This paid, supplemental support program is available to select partners.
GitHub Partner Support lets partners open support tickets on behalf of their customers and escalate complex issues to GitHub Support. The partner remains the customer's primary point of contact.
Built on GitHub Enterprise Support, the offering includes accelerated initial response targets and priority case handling. Partner-specific workflows help you create, track, and manage customer support tickets.
GitHub Partner Support is available to select partners. To enroll, contact your Partner Development Manager.

The offering includes up to 50 customer support tickets using the Partner Support SLA per partner per subscription year, shared across the partner's customers. The subscription year starts on the date the partner purchases the offering. Tickets for the partner's own enterprise and customer tickets submitted with standard enterprise support do not count toward this allowance. See Service level agreement response times for the initial response targets.

GitHub partners can purchase GitHub Partner Support, which provides:
- Written support, in English, through our support portal 24 hours per day, 7 days per week
- Phone support via callback request, in English, through our support portal 24 hours per day, 7 days per week (when required to scope the issue)
- Screen share request for critical issues
- A Service Level Agreement (SLA) with guaranteed initial response times
- Escalation management for High and Urgent priority tickets
Support Engineers have direct access to escalation engineering resources, if needed to expedite case resolution.

You must designate your global GitHub Enterprise Cloud enterprise account on GitHub.com as your partner enterprise. Use this account to grant support entitlements to your engineers. You cannot use a Data Residency tenant or a GitHub Enterprise Server instance as your partner enterprise.
Before opening tickets on behalf of a customer:
1. Make sure each team member who needs to open tickets has a support entitlement in your own partner enterprise.
2. Ask an enterprise owner at the customer's enterprise to approve your partner in their enterprise settings under **Support**. Only a customer enterprise owner can approve or remove a partner.

title: Integration Partners
snippet:
GitHub is a platform focused on empowering the developer tools ecosystem. This partner program provides a simple framework in which we can engage with developer tools companies who are building software on top of GitHub and are ready to start selling their tools to enterprises.

#### Business Requirements
- 5000 GitHub.com application users and at least 10 GitHub Enterprise Server customers
- Information on your GitHub integration publicly available
- Supports GitHub Enterprise Server and GitHub.com
- One (1) public testimonial from a mutual customer
#### Technical Requirements
- Use TLS
- Anytime you display GitHub data in your integration, use TLS. If you also use [webhooks](/webhooks/) to receive updated data from GitHub, use SSL/TLS there too.
- Deleting old user data
- Agrees to delete GitHub user data within 60 days upon valid request.
- Uses the GitHub API best practices:
- Uses webhooks when available, preferable to polling the GitHub API
- Does not require more scopes or GitHub access than needed to perform intended functionality
- Providing users the ability to delete their account via your service.
